description:
Close every running application in one click from the system tray.

Captain Kill Switch is a free system-tray utility that closes every running application in one click - a clean close request first, then a firm stop within two seconds. An allowlist model protects Windows system and session processes. Tiny native app, auto-updates, 10 languages. Anonymous usage statistics only; see https://captainkillswitch.com/privacy.
Immutable installer mirror for v0.2.98. Checksums in SHA256SUMS.txt.
End users should install from https://captainkillswitch.com — these fixed-version assets exist for package managers (winget/AUR/Chocolatey).
